[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Building Trust and Relationships: Developing trust through mutual respect, honesty, and transparency for long-term engagement.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Environmental Impact Assessment and Mitigation: Conducting assessments to identify potential environmental impacts and developing mitigation plans.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Corporate Social Responsibility: Addressing community needs by creating jobs and supporting development initiatives.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Good Governance: Involving communities in policy design to improve transparency and accountability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Conflict Resolution Mechanisms: Establishing platforms for dialogue and negotiation to resolve disputes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Compliance with Regulations: Following local laws to avoid conflicts and build trust.
